form.title: Parish Registration
form.successBody: The parish office will follow up with you. Watch for a copy of this form in your email.
step.getting-started.title: Getting started
step.getting-started.help: This takes about ten minutes. We save your progress as you go, so you can close this and come back.
step.getting-started.intent.label: What would you like to do?
step.getting-started.intent.option.new.h: You are new to us, or you have never filled this out.
step.getting-started.intent.option.updat: You are already registered and something changed.
step.getting-started.parish.label: Which parish?
step.getting-started.envelopeNumber.help: Optional. This helps us find your existing household record.
Optional. Use the ZIP code already on your parish record if it changed.
step.getting-started.privacyNotice.html: This information is used for the purposes of the Church Office only and will not be given out without consent.
step.head.title: Head of household
step.head.help: Start with the adult the parish office should contact first.
step.head-sacraments.title: Sacramental record
step.head-sacraments.help: Answer for yourself. If you are not sure of a date, say so and leave it blank. We can look it up together later.
step.household.title: How we reach you
step.household.check.contactMethods: Please give us at least one way to reach you: an email address or a phone number.
step.household.email.label: Email address
step.household.email.help: Most parish communication goes out by email.
step.household.primaryPhone.label: Primary phone
step.household.mobilePhone.label: Mobile phone
step.household.mailing.label: Mailing address
step.household.home.label: Home address
step.spouse.title: Spouse or second adult
step.spouse.hasSpouse.label: Is there a spouse or second adult in the household?
step.spouse.spouse.label: How we reach them
step.spouse.spouseAddress.label: Their address
step.spouse-sacraments.title: Their sacramental record
step.spouse-sacraments.help: Same questions, for the second adult in the household.
step.children.title: Children
step.children.hasChildren.label: Are there children in the household?
step.children.children.label: Children
step.children.children.help: Add one for each child. There is no limit.
step.photos.title: Photographs
step.photos.help: Parish life gets photographed. Tell us how you would like your household handled.
step.photos.photoNotice.html: Photographs taken at Mass, sacraments, and parish events are sometimes used in the bulletin, in faith formation materials, and on the parish website. Your answer applies to everyone listed on this form and you can change it at any time by calling the parish office.
step.photos.photoConsent.label: May we use photographs of your household in parish publications?
step.photos.photoConsent.option.yes: Yes, our household's photographs may be used.
step.photos.photoConsent.option.no: No, please do not use our household's photographs.
step.review.title: Check your answers
step.review.help: Everything you entered is below. Use Back to change anything.
step.sign.title: Sign and send
step.sign.signNotice.html: This information is used for the purposes of the Church Office only and will not be given out without consent.
step.sign.signature.label: Your signature
